## Change

Describe the behavior, why it matters, and any related public issue.

## Validation

List exact commands, environment or provider when relevant, and observed
results. Include sanitized diagnostics or screenshots only as needed.

## Contribution context

Identify copied or adapted material and its licence. Keep credentials, keys,
VM data and customer information out of this pull request.

## Acceptance for an outside submission

After the final push, the submitting person or authorized representative
posts a separate comment accepting [Vesta Contribution Terms 1.0](https://github.com/Insitu-IT/vesta/blob/main/CONTRIBUTION-TERMS.md)
for the actual full commit ID. Use the appropriate capacity in the
[contribution guide](https://github.com/Insitu-IT/vesta/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contribution-rights).

> I accept Vesta Contribution Terms 1.0 (SHA-256 435d4d5e0aa86c21b13ca6fe6c54fd01f4ec105b01a7cac82d113ca154c781ab) for commit FULL_COMMIT_ID. I act for myself.

An authorized representative uses the final sentence **I act for an
organization I am authorized to represent.** For a transferred patch, use
`patch SHA-256 FULL_PATCH_SHA256` in place of `commit FULL_COMMIT_ID`.

For a confidential exchange, ask on this pull request or choose **Private follow-up** in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Insitu-IT/vesta/issues/new/choose). Keep personal records and employer documents out of the request. Confirm the new revision after any further push.
